en: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?”

zh: 西弗人來對掃羅說：「大衛豈不是在我們那裏藏身嗎？」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。ダビデによる黙想の詩。ジフ人がサウルのもとに来て、「ダビデは私たちの間に隠れているではありませんか」と言ったとき。

p.src: 1  Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

ja: ってください。 あなたの
en: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
u.src: 1  Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

p.src: 2  Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

en: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
u.src: 2  Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

p.src: 3  For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

ja: の魂を追い求めているからだ。
en: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
u.src: 3  For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

p.src: 4  Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

ja: えてくださる方である。
en: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
u.src: 4  Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

p.src: 5  He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

ja: いられる。 あなたの
en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
u.src: 5  He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

p.src: 6  With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

ja: は自発のささげ物を、あなたにささげる。
en: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
u.src: 6  With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

p.src: 7  For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

en: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
u.src: 7  For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
